items.summary: Recommend containment-only execution and no new spend, monetization expansion, billing changes, or queue admission this cycle. Supported revenue is limited to 6,219 Amazon clicks, 28 ordered items, 6 shipped items, and $4.92 commission for 2026-09-21; the $4.92 is in an aggregate provider row and is not site-attributable. Contribution margin, ROI, payback, forecasts, infrastructure spend, budget exposure, and cost-to-learn are unknown because matching-period allocated costs and approved learning thresholds are unavailable. September 1-29 AI usage is $947.39859535 across 5,289 calls, but it cannot be compared to one revenue day or treated as financial performance. Continue only existing period-aligned reconciliation and deployed-work measurement using existing telemetry.

The minimum evidence to calculate contribution margin and cost-to-learn is a dated ledger matching each revenue item and allocable cost item to the same site or content identifier and period, including AI, infrastructure, domain, and other operating costs, plus an approved learning threshold and outcome definition. Until then, do not use clicks, ordered items, shipped items, sessions, impressions, proposal counts, or delivery throughput as revenue, profit, ROI, or learning claims. The 63% approved-proposal execution rate and 5 proven improvements are operational indicators only.

AI usage cost is known only for 2026-09-01 through 2026-09-29: $947.39859535, 5,289 calls, 229 errors, and 5 transient errors across 39 instrumented sites. Average AI cost per call is approximately $0.1792, but cost per learning or acquisition is not calculable because learning outcomes, attributable revenue, and approved thresholds are absent. Infrastructure spend is unknown because operations deploy, uptime, and error sweeps have no results; fixed monthly costs, marketing budget, and revenue floor are blank. Authorize no spend until these fields are reconciled.

Reject both deferred control-plane proposals for CFO retention this cycle. Their operational metrics—duplicate admissions, execution rate, repair backlog, and cycle time—do not establish financial return, contribution margin, or cost-to-learn. They may remain CEO/CTO operational considerations, but no CFO proposal is created because the existing finance reconciliation work already covers the evidence gap.
